extraction_notes: P-channel polarity and signed p-channel values are preserved as printed.
VGS(th) has no typical value in the datasheet; only Min and Max are published.
RDS(ON) publishes Typ and Max for all three VGS/ID pairs; both are retained as separate strict-schema points.
Transfer, output, and capacitance curves were digitized from the usable plots on p. 3. The transfer figure does not state a VDS condition, so none is inferred.
The capacitance figure is plotted over VDS from 0 V to -20 V; the tabulated capacitance test condition is VDS = -10 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz.
The datasheet publishes no typical value for BVDSS, IDSS, or VSD; the available guaranteed bounds are retained where represented by the strict schema.
